instructions.title: Inspect Habitat Water and Nutrient Reserves
instructions.message: Open the existing Habitat Water and Nutrition display.
instructions.guidance: Record only values shown by that display and identify them as simulated configuration telemetry.

instructions.title: Review the Sol 6 Cultivation Experiment
instructions.message: Open the existing Research Zone Cultivation Environment display.
instructions.guidance: Review the persisted experiment and sample record. Preserve the original identity and provenance; mark missing history unavailable.

instructions.title: Inspect Cultivation Rack 01
instructions.message: Use the cultivation application to inspect Rack 01 separately.
instructions.guidance: Only associate measurements with a rack if the project provides an explicit mapping. Otherwise record the mapping as unavailable.

instructions.title: Inspect Cultivation Rack 02
instructions.message: Inspect Rack 02 using its independent record.
instructions.guidance: Do not copy Rack 01 data. Clearly identify unavailable rack-specific measurements.

instructions.title: Diagnose the Main Water Supply
instructions.message: Open the existing Engineering Life Support Resource display.
instructions.guidance: The inspected project has simulated reserve/recycling metrics but no verified main-supply status or Board and Supply display mapping. Record unknown values as unknown.

instructions.title: Restore the Main Water Supply
instructions.message: Return to Engineering and review available water-system controls.
instructions.guidance: Do not claim restoration without a supported repair mapping and a validated system result. Record unresolved source limitations for the report.
instructions.activity: Verify the supported water recovery result.

instructions.title: Verify Cultivation Irrigation
instructions.message: Review irrigation status for both cultivation racks independently.
instructions.guidance: Run a per-rack verification only where the project maps the data to that rack. Do not infer rack results from chamber data.
instructions.activity: Record separate Rack 01 and Rack 02 results.

instructions.title: Verify Nutrient Distribution
instructions.message: Review nutrient supply and mixing information in the existing Research Zone data.
instructions.guidance: No pH, EC, or concentration targets are inferred. Record unavailable measurements explicitly.
instructions.activity: Save nutrient verification or its limitation.

instructions.title: Review Cultivation and Water-System Evidence
instructions.message: Review the saved mission evidence before report submission.
instructions.guidance: Keep historical Sol 6 records separate from Sol 9 findings and preserve unresolved faults.

instructions.title: Submit the Sol 9 Report
instructions.message: Submit the final assessment at Mission Control.
instructions.guidance: Include source provenance, simulated values, unavailable mappings, recovery status, rack-specific findings and outstanding blockers.

completion.title: Sol 9 Assessment Complete
completion.message: The Sol 9 report is recorded. No later Sol starts automatically.

constraints: Navigation guides the player and never completes tasks.
Do not invent rack mappings, equipment, controls, measurements or repair results.
Preserve all Sol 1–8 progress and records.
